title: Untrusted external model source (Experiment 7)
demonstrates: An externally published model is accepted only with a valid signature from a registered, unrevoked publisher and unmodified bytes; unsigned models are refused. A trusted publisher can still ship a backdoor: the signature proves origin and integrity, not safety.

variants.title: Trusted registered publisher signs the model
variants.attack: model signed by release-bot@trusted-model-hub.example, key registered as model_publisher

variants.title: Fine-tuned on the trusted external model, deployed
variants.attack: stage 3 fine-tuning with the external model as parent; gateway decision

variants.title: Unknown / unregistered publisher
variants.attack: model signed by uploader@unknown-model-mirror.example whose key is not in the trust store
evidence: V3 FAIL: signing key ed25519:a55889fa69d5bd7f is not in the trust store

variants.title: Trusted publisher's model modified after signing
variants.attack: one bit of the downloaded weights flipped before import
evidence: V1 FAIL: file content differs from the signed artifact

variants.title: Unsigned external model (no manifest)
variants.attack: weights offered without any publisher manifest
evidence: import: unsigned external model: no publisher manifest/signature supplied

variants.title: Manifest with its signature stripped
variants.attack: publisher manifest kept, signature list emptied
evidence: import: unsigned external model: envelope carries no signature

variants.title: Trusted publisher key later revoked
variants.attack: model_publisher key ed25519:a76334b5a587805d revoked after import
evidence: V4 FAIL: key revoked at 2026-10-15T21:45:28.416324Z (publisher reported key compromise)

variants.title: Model fine-tuned from it, after revocation
variants.attack: re-deploy the E7-A2 model once its external parent's key is revoked

variants.title: LIMITATION: trusted publisher signs a backdoor
variants.attack: publisher trained on 8% corner-trigger poison (label 7), then signed honestly

interpretation: E7-A/A2: a registered publisher's model verifies, is labelled EXTERNAL, and can be fine-tuned and deployed. E7-B/C/E: unknown key, modified bytes and revoked key all FAIL, and the failure propagates to descendants (gateway blocks). E7-D: unsigned models are refused at import. E7-F: a backdoored model from a trusted publisher VERIFIES - attestation moves trust to the publisher, it does not create it.
